about: Which vision questions HOLD a clip (it is not approved) and which are only reported (clipgate2, chosen after the first replay of chapter 1, so its numbers are in-sample; the real test is the clips that get re-made). hold: questions a viewer can answer from the pictures alone, and that gave no alarm on a clip Tom approved. advisory: questions whose answers disagreed with Tom's own approvals in the replay, listed in the report and in the Library, never holding.

advisory.n_name: Flagged all three approved 'give' clips (nothing in the hand) and the approved Windex, as hard as the clips Tom rejected: the model does not know what he accepts for an invented move.
advisory.n_nowave: Same: calls the approved give clips 'waving'.
advisory.p_noobj: Flagged the approved Rose give (a green object) and Windex (the spray).
advisory.m_blink_quick: Flagged the approved Mudling and Big One idles as hard as the Grump's.
advisory.m_pupils: Same: the approved idles show pupils that slide back in a forward-and-back loop.
advisory.m_drops: Never fired in the replay (the Toad's drops come from the backward half of the loop: a bake setting).
